reuse_plan.decision_reason: Adapt cross-round memory and comparison ideas into BanditRLlib's existing zero-sorry, semantic-roundtrip, lifecycle-memory, matched-harness-comparison, and proof-digestion architecture. Preserve the current evidence-gated scheduler rather than assuming multi-agent parallelism is superior.

truth_boundary: This PR changes protocol, machine-checked contribution contracts, and curated process memory. It proves no new Bandit/RL theorem; does not retroactively mark historical proofs source-exhaustive or PURIFIED; does not convert API/environment failures into negative mathematics; and does not claim master-worker parallelism is superior without matched experiments.
